customer_name: Cairns and Hinterland Hospital and Health Service
business_problem: CHHHS needed to replace spreadsheet-heavy budgeting and compliance processes with a system that could combine HR, finance, training, and historical records into accurate real-time views without constant schema maintenance.
solution_summary: Cairns and Hinterland Hospital and Health Service rebuilt its Enterprise Budgeting System and compliance dashboards on MongoDB Enterprise Advanced after SQL Server and multiple schemas became too rigid for real-time and historical reporting. The team stores flexible JSON-style records in MongoDB, pulls data from HR, financial, and training systems into the platform, and uses aggregation pipelines to create consolidated single views for tools such as Sirtboard and Enterprise Budgeting. That document model lets CHHHS keep source data intact while reshaping it for budgeting, compliance, and forecasting use cases without back-end schema changes. MongoDB Enterprise Advanced also meets hospital security requirements. The platform already supports very large operational datasets, and the team is preparing to move to MongoDB Atlas on Azure so infrastructure and security automation shift out of the internal team and more effort can go into new healthcare service applications.

solution_components.name: MongoDB Enterprise Advanced
solution_components.role: Stores budgeting and compliance data, merges multiple operational sources, and supports aggregation pipelines for single-view reporting.

data_flow: HR, finance, training, and budgeting data are pulled into MongoDB Enterprise Advanced, aggregation pipelines merge the siloed sources into single views, and dashboards and planning tools query those documents in real time for compliance and budgeting decisions.
business_outcome: MongoDB gave CHHHS real-time budgeting and compliance analytics, more flexible year-over-year planning, and enough efficiency to redirect manual data-processing effort toward higher-value work.
metrics: "keeping track of over 2,000 unique job types in 12 organizational streams was becoming almost impossible."
"the new mandatory compliance and training dashboard, Sirtboard, can handle over half a million individual records, while Enterprise Budgeting now manages as many as 700,000 budget lines."
"at least two full-time staff who previously processed data manually can now focus on higher-value priorities."
architecture_clues: Aggregation pipelines create consolidated views from multiple operational systems.
The platform supports both real-time and historical reporting.
CHHHS is preparing to move the MongoDB deployment to MongoDB Atlas on Azure.

"We didn't throw anything away; we kept it all and wrote aggregation pipelines to bring all the data together into single views."
"MongoDB has enabled us to achieve real-time analytics for Enterprise Budgeting."
